mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate coupled with rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market recovery, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines with PAYEMS rises over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000 units, it indicates construction sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output, increasing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO rises over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index exceeds 236.5, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 236.5 over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low-GDP regimes (GDPC1 < 15800.0), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 < 15800.0 and HOUST declines over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.
